tools.name: WixREADME
tools.description:
# Tool: WixREADME
The context every other Wix tool assumes. Call it first, once per conversation, for any Wix task or question; for another site later in the conversation, call `GetSiteContext` instead of calling this again.
A Wix task includes reading or changing a site's or account's data: product

tools.name: ReadFullDocsArticle
tools.description:
Fetches the full Wix docs article or method article with code examples for using the method.
Docs articles looks like this: https://dev.wix.com/docs/... and they can either be general docs articles or method articles.
Also reads Wix skills pages — https://www.wix.com/skills/<skill>, https://dev.wix.

tools.name: ReadFullDocsMethodSchema
tools.description:
Fetches the full method schema for a given method.
This will give you the entire request/response schema with all the fields and their descriptions.
For REST and SDK API-reference methods, prefer SearchWixAPISpec when it is available: it can fetch and inspect the exact method schema by docs URL, ret

tools.name: BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu
tools.description:
Browse the Wix REST API documentation menu hierarchy.
Alternative to SearchWixRESTDocumentation - use this to explore and discover APIs by navigating the menu structure instead of searching by keywords.
- Omit the `menuUrl` param to see top-level categories

tools.name: CallWixSiteAPI
tools.description:
Call apis on site "OhGiftPlease" (https://www.ohgiftplease.com/_api/mcp). Use this to perform an action on visitor's behalf, for example, query the site's data or book an appointment.
Before calling this tool, you should ALWAYS check the rest docs (use "SearchSiteApiDocs" tool) for the specific API

tools.name: GenerateVisitorToken
tools.description:
Create a new visitor session and obtain a visitor access token for site "OhGiftPlease" (https://www.ohgiftplease.com/_api/mcp).
You must use this tool before calling CallWixSiteAPI for this first time.
If you already have a visitor token in your context, DO NOT USE THIS TOOL AGAIN.

tools.name: SearchSiteApiDocs
tools.description:

tools.description:
Run JavaScript against the Wix REST API on site "OhGiftPlease" (https://www.ohgiftplease.com/_api/mcp), on the visitor's behalf. The code runs in a sandbox and you get back whatever it returns.

PREFER THIS TOOL OVER CallWixSiteAPI. CallWixSiteAPI makes a single HTTP request; ExecuteWixAPI runs real

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Private data: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Public sink: WixREADME, GetBusinessDetails, ExecuteWixAPI · Destructive: ExecuteWixAPI.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, ReadFullDocsMethodSchema, BrowseWixRESTDocsMenu, CallWixSiteAPI, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Private data: WixREADME, ReadFullDocsArticle, GenerateVisitorToken, SearchSiteApiDocs, GetBusinessDetails, SearchInSite, ExecuteWixAPI · Public sink: WixREADME, GetBusinessDetails, ExecuteWixAPI · Destructive: ExecuteWixAPI

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
